url = "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster"

divers =

origin = 
  rvest::read_html(url) |>

  rvest::html_text2()


divers_df = data.frame(name = divers[1:52], town = origin)

ips = read.csv("../data/toxic_ips_oct2025.csv")
ips$IP
ip_api = function(x) {

  paste0(
    "http://ip-api.com/json/", x,
    "?fields=status,continent,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,district,zip,lat,lon,timezone,currency,isp,org,as,query"
  ) |>
    jsonlite::fromJSON() -> response

  response |> as.data.frame() -> ip_df

  return(ip_df)
}
